description: This React component provides a user interface for downloading a generated Excel report for a document analysis job. It manages download state, handles asynchronous download operations, and displays UI elements such as a button and error messages.

methods.name: ReportDownload({ jobId, onDownload })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a download button for a report, managing download state and errors.

methods.name: triggerDownload
methods.description: Asynchronously triggers the download of the report, handles errors, and updates UI state.
